title: A dependency tree
description:
Show which DLLs a program needs, all the way down, like Dependencies does.

```
game.exe
  engine.dll
    kernel32.dll
    physics.dll
      kernel32.dll (already listed)
  audio.dll
    missing.dll  MISSING
load order: kernel32.dll physics.dll engine.dll audio.dll
```
hints: A depth-first walk with a "visiting" set for cycles and a "done" set for repeats; add a module to the load order after its imports (the load-order practice of lesson 1.02).
`imports.find(name) == imports.end()` means the file could not be found.
requirements: A map from module to the modules it imports; some names have no entry (they are missing).
Print the tree once per module (later visits say "already listed") and detect cycles.
Print a load order where every DLL comes after the ones it needs.
stretch: Mark API-set names (`api-ms-win-...`) as virtual instead of missing.
